literal_clarification: Aspect is computational: 2+2 can be an aspect. Aspect can also be used in analysis as a condition, and can also be an aspect.

normalized_semantics.computational_role: An aspect is a transient computational organization participating in MTO.
normalized_semantics.analytical_role: An aspect may be represented or inspected as a condition during analysis.
normalized_semantics.role_relation: The analytical condition reading does not remove the computational role; both are governed views of the same provisional aspect object.
normalized_semantics.closure_guard: Transient aspect identity remains distinct from persistent RT identity after closure.
